duration.finding: median-duration rule is a single-value predictor: calibration slope unidentifiable and H measured slope 2.61 (outside [0.5,1.5]) on the same data-generating process with 55 episodes; 82 intervals do not change the identifiability structure (p50 ~1 lap, heavy right tail). Duration remains the integration blocker (confirms H).
duration.gate: median-duration predictor; calibration slope in [0.5, 1.5] AND MAE <= 1.0 lap on validation split
duration.on_failure: duration remains the integration blocker (confirms H); no duration component fitted

gap.adequacy: G2/G4 validation evidence rests on tiny contributing sets (~20 gap pairs over 2-3 episodes; ~2-3 spread episodes): full-sample descriptives pass the same thresholds (steady gap median 0.66, spread ratio ~1.01), so the split failures reflect small-N instability, not refutation.
gap.threshold: steady ACTIVE gap-change median <= 1.0s AND p90 <= 3.0s (~2x PRE baseline 0.42/1.53)

pit.v3_status: EXCLUDED at protocol time: pit-loss evidence insufficient (out-lap marginals n=7); fail-closed where pit events are relevant

ending_treatment_in_d.micro_scope: noted but refused post-hoc in D
ending_treatment_in_d.policy: vsc_ending laps excluded from ACTIVE windows; withdrawal onset marker only (rule v2)

episodes.quality_rule: v2 token-semantic (drop entry; drop exit iff direct vsc->all_clear withdrawal)

frozen_parameters.note: E reuses R_cal frozen; E does not refit pace

G1_pace.definition: validation MAE <= 10.0s (H-comparable absolute gate; decontaminated windows)

G2_gap.definition: steady ACTIVE gap-change median <= 1.0s AND p90 <= 3.0s (~2x PRE baseline 0.42/1.53)

G3_order.definition: steady ACTIVE change rate <= 15% (PRE baseline bound 14.4%)

G6_pit_fail_closed.definition: rule specified: refuse VSC simulation crossing pit events under VSC (no validated loss model)

G7_causality.definition: interval semantics causal (C contract); poison-pinned; deterministic

G8_green_parity.definition: GREEN path byte-identical (isolation + frozen suites green)
